#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const int INF = (int) 1e8;

class Node {
public:
    Node *left, *right;
    int batchSetValue;
    bool dirty;
    int min;

    Node() : left(nullptr), right(nullptr), batchSetValue(0), dirty(false), min(INF) {}

    static void setValue(int f, int t, int l, int r, int val, Node *node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return;
        if (f <= l && t >= r) {
            node->setValue(val);
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        setValue(f, t, l, m, val, node->left);
        setValue(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }

    static Node* build(int l, int r) {
        Node *node = new Node();
        if (l != r) {
            int m = (l + r) >> 1;
            node->left = build(l, m);
            node->right = build(m + 1, r);
        }
        return node;
    }

    static int query(int f, int t, int l, int r, Node *node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return INF;
        if (f <= l && r <= t) return node->min;
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        return min(query(f, t, l, m, node->left), query(f, t, m + 1, r, node->right));
    }

    static void update(int i, int l, int r, int val, Node *node) {
        if (i > r || i < l) return;
        if (i <= l && i >= r) {
            node->min = min(node->min, val);
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        update(i, l, m, val, node->left);
        update(i, m + 1, r, val, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }

    static void toArray(int l, int r, vector<int> &data, Node *node) {
        if (l == r) {
            data[l] = node->min;
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        toArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        toArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
    }

    static void fromArray(int l, int r, vector<int> &data, Node *node) {
        if (l == r) {
            node->min = data[l];
            return;
        }
        node->dirty = false;
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fromArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        fromArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }

    void pushUp() {
        this->min = min(left->min, right->min);
    }

    void setValue(int val) {
        this->min = val;
        this->batchSetValue = val;
        this->dirty = true;
    }

    void pushDown() {
        if (dirty) {
            left->setValue(batchSetValue);
            right->setValue(batchSetValue);
            dirty = false;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<vector<int>> intervals(k + 2, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        cin >> intervals[i][0] >> intervals[i][1];
    }
    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;

    ++k;

    vector<Node*> loop(2);
    loop[0] = Node::build(0, n);
    loop[1] = Node::build(0, n);

    vector<int> data(n + 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        Node *curDp = loop[i & 1];
        Node *lastDp = loop[(i - 1) & 1];

        vector<int> interval = intervals[i];
        int intervalLength = interval[1] - interval[0];
        int middleLength = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

        Node::toArray(0, n, data, lastDp);
        for (int j = n; j >= 0; --j) {
            if (j + intervalLength + middleLength <= n) {
                data[j + intervalLength + middleLength] = data[j];
            }
        }
        fill(data.begin(), data.begin() + min((int)data.size(), intervalLength + middleLength), INF);

        int minX = interval[1] - middleLength - intervalLength;
        int maxX = interval[1] - middleLength;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            int minNeedTime = Node::query(minX - j, maxX - j, 0, n, lastDp);
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 1);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            int minNeedTime = Node::query(j - middleLength - intervalLength, j - middleLength, 0, n, lastDp);
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2);
        }

        Node::fromArray(0, n, data, curDp);
    }

    int minFlipTime = Node::query(n, n, 0, n, loop[k & 1]);

    if (minFlipTime < INF) {
        cout << "Full" << endl;
        cout << minFlipTime << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry" << endl;
    }

    // Clean up memory (optional, but good practice)
    delete loop[0];
    delete loop[1];

    return 0;
}
